Get metadata.

Source: R/AnansiWeb-methods.R
metadata.Rd

Get metadata.

Arguments

x

input object

...

additional arguments

Value

metadata slot of x

Details

Compatible with S4Vectors generic.

Examples

x <- randomWeb(10)
metadata(x)
